job.job_description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Backend Application Developer with strong Python and Django fundamentals who has experience building agentic systems. You will be responsible for the work that spans application logic, data infrastructure, and AI integration designing APIs, modelling data, and building the agent and retrieval systems that make our products intelligent.

This is a role for engineers who like working across the full path of a request: from the API route to the database query to the LLM call that drives behaviour. You will write production Django code, work with PostgreSQL and pgvector, and build the prompt, retrieval, and tool-calling systems that sit on top.
You will work closely with the design and product team to translate product behaviour into systems that are reliable, measurable, and built to last.




Responsibilities

Develop production-grade web applications using Django and Django REST Framework
Design and implement scalable RESTful APIs with clean contracts and clear versioning
Build LLM-powered features: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool calling, and structured output systems
Apply context engineering practices design system prompts, manage context windows, and structure retrieval and tool outputs for reliable agent behaviour
Design PostgreSQL schemas, including vector storage with pgvector for embeddings and semantic search
Integrate LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) and orchestrate multi-step agent flows
Write evals and monitoring for LLM-driven features measure quality, not just uptime
Implement async task processing for long-running jobs (LLM calls, data pipelines, batch operations)
Handle server-side security, data validation, and business logic
Optimize query performance, caching strategies, and application throughput
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical planning



To Qualify for the Role, You Should Have

Hands-on experience building production backend applications with Python
Demonstrable expertise in Django and Django REST Framework, with applications you can show or describe in detail
Hands-on experience integrating agentic workflows into production or substantial side projects
Practical experience with context engineering designing system prompts, structuring retrieval and tool outputs, and managing context windows for LLM features
Demonstrable expertise of PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization
Practical experience with vector databases (pgvector or similar) and embedding-based retrieval
Experience with agent frameworks (Pydantic AI or similar) or hand-rolled tool-calling systems
A portfolio, GitHub profile, or detailed write-ups of projects demonstrating your backend and AI/agentic work
You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams as well as clients



What We Look For

Engineers who have shipped real things production applications or substantial side projects.
Passionate about staying current with backend practices, AI tooling, and the evolving landscape of agentic development.
Care for the product experience driven to put working software in front of real users



Technologies and Tools

Languages and Frameworks: Python, Django, Django REST Framework
Databases: PostgreSQL, pgvector
AI and Agents: Pydantic AI, LLM provider SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic), Agentic Browsers
Async and Background Jobs: Celery, Redis
AI-Assisted Development: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex



What We Offer

Ownership of meaningful systems work across the application, data, and intelligence layers
A growth path into deeper AI engineering model customization, eval methodology, and agent infrastructure
Exposure to international product work
A team that uses AI tools daily and treats engineering craft seriously



Required Candidate profile

As the old-world collapses and new digital world is being built around us, we are offering selected candidates an opportunity to make a mark in the ever-changing world of internet communications. We are a team of pioneering professionals in internet communications and are currently working on some marquee international projects. We are looking for 5 qualities apart from some basic technology skills in an ideal candidate.


Passion
Sincerity
Perseverance
Willingness to work hard
Capacity and readiness to learn, unlearn and relearn



We will take care of the rest.
